scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Mary Magdalene approaches a rock-cut tomb at predawn and looks toward its open entrance; a large stone stands beside it among rocks and flowers.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of John 20:1: Mary Magdalene comes to the tomb early while it is still dark and sees the stone removed. The setting and appearance are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A distressed woman gestures urgently as she speaks to two concerned disciples on a stone path; an open rock-cut tomb and a village appear behind them in the morning light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 20:2, showing the woman telling Simon Peter and the other disciple that the Lord has been taken from the tomb and that they do not know where he has been laid. The setting and appearance of the people are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two disciples hurry along a sunlit garden path toward a rock-cut tomb, surrounded by flowers, trees, and hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 20:3, in which Peter and the other disciple go toward the tomb. The setting and their appearance are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two men run along a rocky path toward a rock-cut tomb; the leading disciple reaches its entrance while Peter follows behind.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene based on John 20:4, where the two run together and the other disciple runs ahead of Peter and reaches the tomb first.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man bends outside a rock-cut tomb and looks at pale linen cloths lying on a stone surface inside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 20:5: he stoops and sees the linen cloths lying there, but does not enter. The setting and appearance are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Simon Peter looks at pale linen cloths lying on a stone resting place inside a rock-hewn tomb, while another man stands at the entrance.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 20:6, in which Simon Peter enters the tomb and sees the linen cloths lying there. The setting, appearances, and arrangement are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit rock-hewn tomb, a folded ivory cloth rests alone on a stone ledge, separated from loose linen cloths nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 20:7, showing the cloth that had been on His head folded separately from the linen cloths. The tomb setting and light are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A disciple pauses inside a sunlit rock-hewn tomb, looking with wonder at a stone burial place draped with pale linen.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 20:8: the other disciple enters the tomb, sees, and believes. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two thoughtful men stand beside an open rock-cut tomb at dawn, one holding an unlettered scroll; folded linen rests inside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes their not yet understanding the Scripture that he must rise from the dead. The figures, scroll, tomb setting, and gestures are artistic interpretation rather than details stated in this verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Two disciples in robes walk together along a sunlit stone path toward a village of simple homes, surrounded by trees and wildflowers.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of the disciples going away again to their homes in John 20:10. The people and setting are artistic choices, not details specified by the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Mary weeps and bends toward the dark entrance of a rock-cut tomb, surrounded by sunlit stones and flowers.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 20:11, where Mary weeps outside the tomb and stoops to look into it.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman looks toward two white-clad angels seated at opposite ends of an empty stone burial place, in a warmly lit chamber.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative rendering of John 20:12: she sees two angels in white, sitting at the head and feet of the place where Jesus' body had lain.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A tearful woman gestures as she speaks with two attentive men beside a stone opening, surrounded by flowers in warm light.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of the exchange in John 20:13: a woman is asked why she weeps and says her Lord has been taken away and she does not know where he has been laid. The setting and figures' appearance are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A woman turns with a questioning expression toward Jesus, who stands nearby, in a sunlit garden beside a stone opening.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 20:14: after speaking, the woman turns and sees Jesus standing there without knowing that it is him. The garden and visual details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A tearful woman gestures toward Jesus in a flower-filled garden as he looks at her; a stone opening stands behind him.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 20:15: Jesus speaks to the weeping woman, who supposes him to be the gardener and asks where the one she seeks has been laid. The garden details and poses are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Mary turns toward Jesus with an expression of joyful recognition as he reaches toward her in a sunlit garden beside a rock-cut tomb.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 20:16, in which Jesus says Mary’s name and she turns and addresses him as Rabboni, meaning Teacher. The setting and visual details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a flowering garden, Jesus stands speaking to a kneeling woman, holding one hand up as she reaches toward him and extending the other toward a path.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting Jesus' words to the woman in John 20:17: he tells her not to touch him and sends her to tell his brothers that he is ascending to his Father and their Father, his God and their God. The setting and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Mary Magdalene speaks with open hands to a group of attentive disciples in a sunlit stone room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative portrayal of John 20:18, in which Mary Magdalene brings the disciples word that she has seen the Lord and tells them what He said to her.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with open hands among startled disciples in a lamplit room, with a closed wooden door behind them and evening visible through a window.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 20:19: on the evening of the first day of the week, Jesus stands among the disciples behind shut doors and speaks peace to them. The room, appearances, and gestures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus shows his marked hands and side to joyful disciples gathered around him in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 20:20, in which the Lord shows the disciples his hands and side and they rejoice at seeing him. The room, clothing, and individual expressions are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks with open hands to a group gathered in a stone room, with a sunlit path visible through the doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene of Jesus offering peace and sending those he addresses, as the Father sent him. The room, gestures, and path are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus breathes toward a group of attentive disciples gathered in a warmly lit room; delicate pale lines suggest his breath.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 20:22, where Jesus breathes on them and tells them to receive the Holy Spirit. The room, figures and visible breath are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus speaks to attentive listeners in a warmly lit room, with a loose cord and a tied cord on a table in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses loose and tied cords to suggest the verse's contrast between sins forgiven and sins retained; the setting and objects are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands among disciples in a warmly lit room while Thomas walks apart along the street outside.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene reflecting John 20:24: Thomas, called Didymus, was not with the others when Jesus came. The setting and figures are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a warmly lit room, four disciples speak earnestly to a seated man, who points to his palm as he listens and responds.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 20:25: the other disciples say they have seen the Lord, and the listener describes the evidence he says he must see and touch before he will believe. The room and gestures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus stands with open arms among his attentive disciples in a warmly lit room, with a closed wooden door behind them.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 20:26: eight days later the disciples, including Thomas, are inside when Jesus stands among them despite the closed doors and greets them with peace. The setting and appearances are imagined.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus extends a wounded hand toward Thomas and opens his robe to reveal a small wound at his side; Thomas reaches toward him in a warmly lit room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of Jesus inviting Thomas to see his hands and bring his hand to his side, and calling him to believe, in John 20:27. The room, appearance, and gestures are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Thomas kneels and speaks with open hands toward Jesus, who stands facing him in a warmly lit stone room.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative depiction of John 20:28, where Thomas answers and addresses him as his Lord and his God. The setting and gestures are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus gestures gently while speaking with an attentive man in a warmly lit room, with sunlight entering through an open doorway.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative setting for Jesus speaking about seeing and believing and the blessing of those who believe without seeing. The room and gestures are artistic choices, not details specified by John 20:29.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Jesus takes the hand of a seated man on a rocky path while three disciples watch, with a lake and hills beyond.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: An imaginative scene suggesting one of the many other signs Jesus performed before his disciples that John 20:30 says are not written in this book; the verse does not describe this particular event.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A group gathers around a blank scroll in a sunlit courtyard, looking toward Jesus as he opens his arms in a flowering garden.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene reflects the verse's purpose: the written testimony invites belief that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and life in his name. The gathering is not an event narrated by the verse.
